Saracens Broadfields
Enriching Lives Through Education
Welcome to Saracens Broadfields
At Saracens Broadfields, we aim to provide a strong foundation for a happy life, to build upon moral purpose, develop character, build cultural capital, make memories and achieve. We encourage all children to have high expectations for themselves, respect each other, celebrate diversity and become independent learners. We support them to fulfil their true potential.
Our values of Discipline, Hard Work, Honesty, and Humility pervade all areas of our school life. Education is an enlightening experience and we strongly believe that every child can make exceptional progress when inspired by passionate teaching.

pageCache.pageTitle: Values and Ethos – Saracens Broadfields Primary School
pageCache.text:
Values and Ethos
Enriching lives through education by developing lifelong learners who will thrive in life beyond school
Core Values
Our work in the classroom, and in our enrichment activities, is strongly underpinned by the values we share with Saracens Rugby Club:
Discipline: Our schools are orderly, safe and joyful places where pupils are guided in their behaviour by fair and sensible principles
Hard Work: Staff and children work incredibly hard to fulfil their potential and staff labour to continually improve our schools
Honesty: We insist on an honest appraisal of the efforts and attitude of staff in their work and pupils in all areas of their education and school life
Humility: Our teaching styles reflect the culture of success and commitment to character development with attainment celebrated as warmly as achievement
Our Ethos

pageCache.pageTitle: Welcome To Our New Principal – Saracens Broadfields Primary School
pageCache.text:
Saracens Broadfields joined Saracens Education last October and we’re going from strength to strength!
It’s into this successful context that Mrs Marriott has taken up the role of principal.
Mrs Marriott has experience of working in a number of primary schools and comes to us from a nine year term as the headteacher of Pinner Wood School where they achieved ‘outstanding’ from Ofsted in all areas.
Our new principal explains why moving to Saracens Broadfields was such an easy decision:
‘The moment I walked into Saracens Broadfields, I knew this was the place for me. I was immediately struck by the warmth of our community, the dedication of our strong staff team, and our truly exceptional facilities – it genuinely feels like a little countryside in the city!’
A big Broadields welcome to Mrs Marriott, and an enormous thank you to Mrs Keane for leading our school as Acting Principal last year and for continuing with us now as Vice Principal.
Saracens Broadfields, Roseberry Drive, Edgware, HA8 8JP
Tel: 020 8359 5430 | Email: office@saracensbf.org

pageCache.pageTitle: Welcome to Saracens Broadfields – Saracens Broadfields Primary School
pageCache.text:
Welcome to Saracens Broadfields
On behalf of the staff, I would like to warmly welcome you and your family to our school. We are a large primary school in London with the warmth and feel of a small school in the countryside.
It is a real privilege to introduce myself as the Principal of Saracens Broadfields and to welcome you to our school website. Whether you are already part of our school community, considering Saracens Broadfields for your child, or exploring to find out more about us, I hope our website gives you a true sense of what makes our school such a special place to learn and grow.
Saracens Broadfields is a thriving, three-form entry, inclusive primary school set in outer London, welcoming children from Nursery (aged 2) through to Year 6. We are fortunate to have outstanding facilities available to our pupils – giving us the feel of a city school nestled in its own piece of countryside. To support our families beyond the core school day, we also offer exceptional Breakfast and After School Clubs.
At the heart of Saracens Broadfields is a commitment to enriching lives through high-quality education, nurturing lifelong learners who are prepared to thrive well into the future. Simply put, every child matters here. We ensure that each pupil receives the absolute best opportunities and experiences – both inside the classroom and beyond. We take immense pride in being a happy, inclusive, and ambitious school where children are encouraged to achieve highly, build strong character, and develop into responsible, caring members of society.
We are in a unique position as a member of the Saracens Education Trust. Our close connection with the Saracens Rugby Club provides our pupils with a wealth of extraordinary opportunities. We embed the Trust’s core values into daily life, actively encouraging every child to:
I feel incredibly fortunate to lead a dedicated, talented team of staff who care deeply about our children and are committed to delivering the best education. We know that pupils achieve their highest potential when school and families work closely together, which is why building strong, positive partnerships with parents and the wider community is at the centre of our approach.
Most importantly, we are immensely proud of our pupils. Their determination, ambition, and kindness make them stand out and drive their incredible achievements.
I warmly invite you to come and visit us, meet our children and staff, and experience the energy of our school firsthand.
I look forward to welcoming you to Saracens Broadfields soon.
Mrs Marriott Principal
Work Hard: Strive for personal excellence always
Saracens Broadfields, Roseberry Drive, Edgware, HA8 8JP
Tel: 020 8359 5430 | Email: office@saracensbf.org

Wraparound Care
Wraparound care is out-of-school childcare for primary school-aged children, providing care before and after the regular school day. It helps parents and carers balance work and family life by offering supervised care, breakfast, and activities.
Breakfast
Children can arrive at 7.55am for breakfast. Food available includes a choice of cereals, toast with various spreads and juice. Children are welcome to do their homework at breakfast club.
The cost is £2/child
After School
We will look after children until 6pm. They can play with their friends, do their homework, read or just relax.
After school club is for children in Reception – Year 6. This club is not for children in Nursery.

pageCache.pageTitle: Community Clubs – Saracens Broadfields Primary School
pageCache.text:
Community Clubs
At Saracens Broadfields our children get involved in many activities and clubs outside of school to help enrich their lives and boost confidence. Here are some of the activities we know our pupils attend.
Kaleidoscope Theatre & Arts.
Where children of all ages can learn to dance in a welcoming, professional, safe and fun environment. Give your child a chance to learn, develop and have fun with Kaleidoscope Theatre Arts in Edgware.
Hendon & Mill Hill Ballet School
Hendon & Mill Hill Ballet School provide classical ballet lessons for children age 2 and a half to 16, training to exam level from beginner to pre-professional. Classes are taught through the Cecchetti Classical Ballet method, regulated by the Imperial Society of Teachers of Dancing (ISTD), and are accompanied by a live pianist.
Susan Ford School of Dancing
Susan Ford School of Dancing is a recommended professional dance school based in Hatfield. We offer a range of excellent dance classes including ballet, tap and modern jazz, for both adults and children. Our main objective is to generate a nurturing environment, encouraging our pupils to achieve their full potential. You will get ample opportunities to participate in shows and competitions. Dance examinations are also conducted for each batch.
West Hampstead School of Dance
West Hampstead School of Dance are the classical ballet school in North West London!
With studios in Hampstead, West Hampstead, Golders Green, Kilburn and Swiss Cottage, we specialize solely in classical ballet and following the RAD syllabus. Our highly qualified teachers, often with two working together in each class, are accompanied by pianists delivering inspiring classes, encouraging the love of dance.
Spotlight Performing Arts
Spotlight Performing Arts is a North London theatre school with a difference, we offer a fresh approach to the performing arts with an inspirational and dedicated team of professional teachers who will nurture young talent in a safe, fun and friendly atmosphere. Each one of our students is treated as an individual and the skills that they learn will help them throughout their life. Our students are happy, confident and enthusiastic. Of course the priority at Spotlight is always to have fun!
Bodens Drama School
Bodens Drama School in Enfield or Barnet offer performing arts courses for young people aged 7 – 16 years at the weekends. They work in groups of eighteen in the same age range on acting, applied theatre, singing and dancing. In acting, we cover a range of practitioners and methods. In singing, we work on technique and performance, using a repertoire of musical theatre and popular music. In dance, we develop ability, knowledge of movement and choreographic skills, through modern, musical theatre, contemporary, urban and commercial dance. Classes last for three hours and regularly work towards performances.
Perform
Perform is a different type of drama school. Who use a unique mix of drama, dance and singing – specially developed and written by us – to bring out every child’s true potential.
Classes are kept small to ensure lots of individual attention by our experienced teachers. They’ll focus on your child’s enthusiasm and engagement in the activities rather than their precision and ability to learn moves.
The Ebony & Ivory Music School
The Ebony & Ivory Music School offers tuition in a wide range of musical instruments and genres. We have 27 fully qualified & CRB checked teachers who teach around 600 music lessons a week at our premises in Colindale, North-West London.
JCM Music School
JCM Music School offer tuition on a variety of popular instruments including guitar, piano, singing, and percussion.
The teachers are well-qualified, approachable, and enthusiastic about their work. We are dedicated to providing quality musical education and our knowledge is backed by years of teaching and performance experience. All of us are fully CRB checked.
We welcome pupils of all ages and abilities, offering tuition from beginner level to advanced studies. We try to tailor our approach to your requirements, whether your goal is pursue a career in music, achieve graded exams, or simply learn to play with ease and confidence.
Scouts
There are hundreds of Scout groups around the country and lots of local ones too. Two popular local ones with our pupils are:
21st Hendon (3rd Mill Hill) Scouts
Scouting is split into three age groups:
Beavers is for 6-8 year-olds Cubs is for 8-10½ year-olds Scouts is for 10-14½ year-olds
Scouts offers challenge and adventure to 400,000 young people and 100,000 adults across the UK. We believe in helping our Members fulfil their potential by working in teams, learning by doing and thinking for themselves. We give people of every background the chance to stretch themselves, learn new skills and make lifelong friends.
Harrow School of Gymnastics
Harrow School of Gymnastics provide a safe and stimulating environment for gymnastics classes at all levels, from Pre-School to Adult Gym. Most of those involved enjoy recreational Gymnastics working for British Gymnastics awards and competing in the Club Championships. The performance section comprising Women’s Artistic and Men’s Artistic, gives an opportunity for talented gymnasts to compete within the Club, at Regional, National and International levels.
Hendon Gymnastics Club
Hendon Gymnastics Club is a highly renowned, professionally coached gymnastics club operated from within Hendon Leisure Centre. With their purpose-built multi-functional gymnasium, Hendon Gymnastics Club are able to train and coach from junior and youth levels to adults. Hendon Gymnastics Club is able to cater from beginners to elite gymnastics and have highly skilled coaches to appropriately and effectively coach them through long term development.
Tiska Karate
Tiska Karate is taught in 5 locations Mill Hill, Edgware, Hendon, Finchley & Hornsey. All the five clubs were are under the instruction of Mr C Gregory (5th Dan), who started karate at the age of 14. Our club members come from varied backgrounds and started karate for many different reasons eg. Fitness, Confidence, Discipline, Self Defence, Bullying or just social. Currently we have a good balance of adults (male and Female) and children from Beginner to Red Belts.
Kenton Martial Arts
Kenton Martial Arts is a centre of excellence for the study of Choi Kwang Do
Choi Kwang Do is a modern martial art which emphasizes the ideal of personal and social development over sports competition. If you are looking for a martial art that will help you improve your fitness levels, self confidence and equip you with real self defence skills, we can help you achieve your goal.
Based in Kenton, Harrow and opened in 2003 – We offer programmes to people of all ages and are committed to provide you with a safe and non-competitive environment to help you grow not only physically but mentally too.
Top Shot Tennis
At TopShotTennis.net, our philosophy is to offer everyone the opportunity to get the most out of tennis. Whether it’s tots learning hand eye co-ordination with balloons and floor tennis, older kids learning mini tennis on smaller courts with easier to hit balls or people who’ve always fancied a go but never had the chance, at TopShotTennis.net we have the expertise to help absolute beginners, returners, improvers and club standard players. LTA qualified coach and referee, Jonty formed TopShotTennis.net to provide high quality, great fun tennis coaching using the latest tennis equipment to help people get the most out of tennis.
Stanmore Cricket Club
The club welcomes new members of all levels to maintain the high standards set by the past players.
Established in 1853, Stanmore Cricket Club celebrated 170 years of existence in 2023. The club is one of the oldest institutions in the North West of London. Stanmore CC prides itself on the friendly atmosphere, excellent facilities and a comfortable clubhouse and her very close proximity to the Stanmore Underground station.
Saracens Rugby Camp
The Saracens Rugby Camp programme has courses available for all mini and junior playing age groups and provides organised, educational, inclusive and structured activities. Utilising our experienced, qualified and award-winning coaches from the Saracens Rugby Development Team, we are able to incorporate a vast range of techniques and skills included in the ever evolving game of rugby
Aspire Leisure Centre
The Aspire Leisure Centre was the first fully accessible Training Centre in Europe for disabled and non-disabled people.
Currently, around a third of the members are disabled, which compares with a national average of 2-3% in other sports centres. We proactively encourage disabled people to join and take part in all activities by subsidising their membership and activity costs and offer a fully Inclusive Fitness Initiative approved fitness studio.
Swimming Lessons are provided in a calm and relaxed environment where your child can learn to swim or improve their technique. All our swimming instructors are qualified to ASA standard so you can feel secure in the knowledge that they are in safe hands and learning from the experts.
The Venue
The Venue is a great place to get fit, have fun and meet friends or Pop in for a swim, The Venue is also complemented by a 25m Swimming Pool, Teaching Pool, Crèche and Soft Play. We have a wide programme of activities for all ages & abilities.
St Margaret’s Sports Centre
St Margaret’s Sports Centre is a modern and well equipped sports facility that caters for a wide range of sports and leisure activities as well as offering an extensive range of courses and qualification opportunities. Set in idyllic surroundings the facilities include a large Main Hall, multi-purpose studio, fully equipped Fitness Studio, indoor and outdoor Netball courts and a heated 25m luxury swimming pool.
Barnet Copthall Swimming Club
Barnet Copthall Swimming Club has an environment where all swimmers, both young and old, can enjoy, participate and compete in all swimming disciplines, in surroundings where they can develop friendship, sportsmanship, responsibility, dedication and self-discipline.
A great many of our swimmers have and continue to represent their chosen countries at all major international championships. They have shown commitment and dedication that extends in life during and beyond their swimming career
Oakleigh Park School of Swimming
We are now celebrating 50 years of swimming! Oakleigh Park School of Swimming was established in 1975. We pride ourselves on offering swimming lessons with restricted numbers to ensure maximum progress.
Oakleigh Park School of Swimming was established in 1975 and the manager is Jonathan Rolfe. His parents, Ron and Pam, have worked in swimming for over fifty years and they met when Ron taught Pam to swim! It was whilst teaching all those years ago they realised that teaching swimming in cold water and with the public all around was not working. Land was acquired at the tennis club in Whetstone, which is still on the same grounds in Oakleigh Road North and building commenced.
Mill Hill School of Swimming
The long-established Mill Hill School of Swimming, now operating in a newly built competition sized pool, offers lessons to children (from the ages of 3 and up) and adults of any range and ability.
Little Kickers
Little Kickers gives children a positive introduction to sport by teaching high quality football skills in a friendly, pressure-free environment.
There are four different classes tailored specifically to the needs of children between 18 months and seven years of age.
It’s the perfect way to ignite an enthusiasm for sport that will stay with them for life.
Excel Sport
Excel Sport are keen to coach children of all standards and abilities. At Excel Sport F.C. all children are welcome, we really do cater for the complete beginner to the budding superstar.
Excel Sport is recognised as a respected training ground and maintains strong links with the following Professional Clubs; Chelsea, Arsenal, Tottenham, Fulham & Watford. Each season a number of our children will go on to train at this level, however, the vast majority come to Excel to learn the game and improve their skills for their own enjoyment or to compete at school or club level.
Our ethos has always been to provide football coaching to children of all standards and abilities, to build confidence whilst learning new skills and above all to have lots of fun.

A Well Celebrated Subject
Philosophy
Six underlying attributes at the heart of Saracens Broadfields’ curriculum and lessons:
Let’s think… Disciplinary Knowledge!
At Saracens Broadfields, disciplinary knowledge in Science refers to the understanding of how scientific knowledge is generated, tested, and applied. It equips pupils with the skills and habits of mind needed to think and work like scientists.
Let’s think… Substantive Knowledge!
At Saracens Broadfields, every lesson is started with the big North Star Question. Children are given the opportunity so share what they know at the start of the lesson. They revisit the North Star question at the end. Using their purple pens, children show off their new substantive knowledge!

SEND
At Saracens Broadfields we aim to make every effort to secure provision for any child with Special Educational Needs or Disabilities (SEND) and to improve their outcomes through high aspirations and expectations
All Barnet Local Authority (LA) schools are expected to identify and support pupils with special educational needs and to support them in making the best possible progress. Schools are required to be inclusive, with the needs of pupils with special educational needs and disabilities being met in a mainstream setting wherever possible. Schools have a duty to publish SEN information on their website that is reviewed annually. The Local Authority is also expected to publish information about services they expect to be available for the children and young people with SEN aged 0-25. This is called the ‘Local Offer’: https://www.barnetlocaloffer.org.uk
The intention of the Local Offer is to improve choice and information being given to families. It will be an important resource for parents and carers in understanding the range of services and provision in their local area.
